adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: A heterozygous loss-of-function ELN variant with familial supravalvular aortic narrowing directly identifies elastin haploinsufficiency. ELN encodes elastin, the arterial extracellular-matrix protein reduced in this arteriopathy.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Fibrillin-1, type III collagen, type I collagen, and laminin are real extracellular-matrix proteins but are encoded by different genes and cause different syndromes; none is the product of ELN.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: Because the gene is explicitly provided, the only defensible protein answer is elastin; no additional phenotype assumption is needed.
